national.title: Cerita di Balik Puing Pan Am Ditemukan di Bali Usai Setengah Abad Lebih
national.summary: Pemandu wisata Winaryo menemukan puing pesawat Pan Am 812 di Buleleng, Bali, saat survei jalur canyoning. Temuan ini mengungkap kembali tragedi 50 tahun lalu.

international.title: Pakistani man sentenced to 27 years in US prison over Trump murder plot
international.summary: Asif Merchant, allegedly linked to Iran, found by court to have sought retribution over Qassem Suleimani death A Pakistani man was sentenced to more than 27 years in prison on Tuesday for plotting to assassinate Donald Trump in retaliation for the US killing of Revolutionary Guards commander Qassem Suleimani, the Department of Justice said. Asif Merchant, who had alleged ties to Iran, sought to hire a hitman to assassinate a politician or a government official in the United States, a Brooklyn court found. Continue reading...
